description: This PHP class defines the data access object (DAO) for retrieving screen permissions based on modules, actions, and user roles within the OrangeHRM system. It interfaces with the database to fetch ScreenPermission entities filtered by role and page details.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for fetching screen permission data from the database based on module, action, and user roles.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ScreenPermission entities matching the provided module name, action URL, and roles.
